tools.name: conversations_list
tools.intent: List active messaging conversations, optionally filtered by platform or name.

tools.name: conversation_get
tools.intent: Inspect one conversation's details using its session key.

tools.name: messages_read
tools.intent: Read recent message history from a selected conversation.

tools.name: attachments_fetch
tools.intent: Fetch non-text attachments from a specific message.

tools.name: events_poll
tools.intent: Poll for new conversation or approval events after a cursor.

tools.name: events_wait
tools.intent: Wait for the next conversation or approval event with a bounded timeout.

tools.name: messages_send
tools.intent: Send a text message through a connected platform target.

tools.name: channels_list
tools.intent: List available messaging targets across connected platforms.

tools.name: permissions_list_open
tools.intent: List pending approval requests observed by the bridge session.

tools.name: permissions_respond
tools.intent: Allow or deny a pending approval request.
